description: Create an offer, or change one (give its id), as the Get paid dialog's offer form does. price is in whole units of the currency (150 = CHF 150). billing: monthly (renews until cancelled) or once. entry: apply (the coach accepts the athlete before they pay) or buy (straight to checkout) — the coach's choice. places: how many athletes at once, 0 or left out for no limit. A change never alters what an athlete was already asked to pay.

id.description: The offer to change; leave out to create one

places.description: Athletes at once; 0 for no limit

price.description: In whole units of the currency, e.g. 150

name: save_offer
